newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in Kansas Monday, USDA said. Not enough slaughter steer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, no slaughter heifers sales confirmed. Inquiry moderate, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and no slaughter heifers Monday. For the week to date 7,300 head confirmed mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lb Holsteins 59.00.
Confirmed: 300 last week: none last year: none
week to date: 7,300 last week: 5,200 last year: 25,300
